summary: Candidate is a distinct session_skill for file-based data source configuration in Flink DataStream API. It does not match any existing skill by semantic capability (existing skills cover metadata configuration, thread pool management, and page setup—entirely different domains). Peer candidates are sibling data source skills (collection-based, checkpoint configuration, socket-based word count) but represent different source types and fault tolerance concerns, not overlapping file-based source configuration. No merge, split, or revision relationship applies.
